verdict.rationale: Gusto is a SaaS platform that handles sensitive payroll and HR data and ships AI features, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack never mentions any policy or control preventing customer data from being used to train AI models. The robots.txt Content-Signal marker governs crawler use of public web content, and the approve-every-change control governs agent output; both are adjacent features that earn no credit.
